info.name: ERBM Accounting Disbursement API
info.description: Only the newly added Accounting disbursement confirmation API. Set accessToken to an ACCOUNTING token and advanceId to an APPROVED Advance. No body is required. Requires migration 0006 and a restarted server.

request.description: Use an ACCOUNTING accessToken after paying the full approved amount once. No body is required. Transitions APPROVED to ACTIVE and records exact amount, server time, actor and DISBURSE history atomically. Returns 409 for another ACTIVE Advance in the Project, a closed Project, previous payment or non-APPROVED status. Requires migration 0006.
